name: Pious Restoration (PvP)
description: Spell. Gain 80...150 Health and remove 1 Dervish enchantment. Removal effect: lose 1 hexes.

name: Whirling Charge (PvP)
description: Flash Enchantment Spell. (1...6 seconds.) You move 33% faster. Deal 10...50 cold damage to all other nearby foes the next time you hit a foe and this enchantment ends.

name: Aura Slicer (PvP)
description: Melee Attack. (5...15 seconds.) Inflicts Bleeding condition. Also inflicts Cracked Armor (1...10 seconds) if you are enchanted.
